title: 第955章 紫紫啊再不来你要守活寡了第954章 碾压取下尔等之首级来祭奠吾儿
content_zh:
“噈！”
即使拼上了浑身解数，可在摩诃帝俊的绝对实力之下，詹台玄坤依旧轰然落败！
伴随着一道凄厉的凤鸣声响彻，七宝金乌枪被震碎，混沌钟被弹飞。
詹台玄坤亦是受到了真龙殒凤斩的正面冲击，自空中急速坠落。
燃烧着三色火焰的羽毛乱飞。
詹台玄坤就这样在林陌等人难以置信的目光之中，重重地坠落在地。
即便涅盘天凤一族有着极强的自愈能力，詹台玄坤仍然在真龙殒凤斩的恐怖余威之下身负重伤！
若非前面有混元龙凤珠、七宝金乌枪以及混沌钟消耗了真龙殒凤斩的大部分威能。
这一剑，詹台玄坤轻则被削去顶上三花，境界跌落。
重则道果被打碎，从此一蹶不振！
甚至说不定还有着陨落的风险！
涅盘天凤族的自愈能力，再加上大乘后期恐怖的生命力是很能抗，但在绝对的实力碾压面前，这一切都是徒劳。
“父亲！！”
“族长大人...”
“.........”
看着那重重坠落在地，身上的三色火焰正在扑腾扑腾地熄灭的詹台玄坤。
詹台朵朵、五大凤主以及众位长老们，无不瞪大了眼睛。
在此之前，他们从未见过如此狼狈的詹台玄坤。
仰望着那盘旋于高天之上，真龙之躯仿若无边无尽的摩诃帝俊，一股深深的绝望气息，笼罩在詹台朵朵等人的心头。
若是连林陌和詹台玄坤联手都束手无策，那么还有谁能够抗衡、能够阻止得了摩诃帝俊？

“哼，蝼蚁！”
摩诃帝俊俯视着下方的林陌、詹台玄坤等人，霸气绝伦道：“吾不过随手一剑，尔等便要拼尽了全部手段了么？”
“看来，吾方才给你定下的小配角定位，十分的准确。”
“若尔等只有这点小手段，吾接下来便要请你们赴死了！”
话落之时。
摩诃帝俊便是再次挥舞起了圣龙剑，似乎不打算给予林陌等人任何的喘息之机。
见此一幕。
詹台朵朵无助地看向林陌，她那金色的凤眸之中，带着最后的希冀。
随着詹台玄坤重伤落败，眼下唯一有机会拯救涅盘天凤族之人，恐怕也仅有林陌一人了...
虽然，林陌的极品圣阶本命至宝，也已经对此时此刻的摩诃帝俊产生不了任何威胁。
但...
除了林陌之外，现在詹台朵朵还能靠谁呢？
“........”
这时，沉默了好一会儿的林陌终是重新抬眸。
他嘴边噙着一抹无奈的苦笑，似乎对于眼下的局面也感到无能为力了。
该说不说，面对着现在这个状态的摩诃帝俊，林陌确实是没招了。
至少。
以他现在的实力，还做不到抗衡手持上品圣阶至宝，有着大乘期圆满修为的摩诃帝俊。
“太古龙经·金龙灭世！”
“吼！”
content_en:
"Gee!"
Even though he tried his best, Zhantai Xuankun was still defeated by Maha Dijun's absolute strength!
Along with a shrill phoenix cry, the Seven Treasures Golden Crow Spear was shattered and the Chaos Bell was ejected.
Zhantai Xuankun also suffered a frontal impact from the True Dragon Death Phoenix Slash and fell rapidly from the air.
Feathers burning with three-color flames flew around.
Zhan Tai Xuankun just fell heavily to the ground under the disbelieving gazes of Lin Mo and others.
Even though the Nirvana Tianfeng clan has extremely strong self-healing capabilities, Zhantai Xuankun was still seriously injured by the terrifying residual power of the True Dragon Death Phoenix Slash!
If it weren't for the Hunyuan Dragon and Phoenix Pearl, the Seven Treasures Golden Crow Spear and the Chaos Bell, most of the power of the True Dragon Death Phoenix Slash would have been consumed.
With this sword, Zhan Tai Xuan Kun was cut off from his top three flowers, and his realm fell.
At worst, the Dao Fruit will be shattered and never recover!
There might even be a risk of falling!
The self-healing ability of the Nirvana Tianfeng clan, coupled with the terrifying vitality of the late Mahayana, is very resistant, but in the face of absolute crushing strength, all this is in vain.
"Father!!"
"Lord Patriarch..."
"..."
Looking at Zhan Tai Xuankun who fell heavily to the ground, the three-color flames on his body were extinguishing.
Zhan Tai Duoduo, the five Phoenix Masters, and all the elders all had their eyes widened.
Before this, they had never seen Zhan Tai Xuankun in such a miserable state.
Looking up at the Maharaja who hovered high in the sky, the body of a real dragon seemed to be boundless, a deep aura of despair enveloped the hearts of Zhan Tai Duoduo and others.
If even Lin Mo and Zhantai Xuankun are helpless together, then who else can compete and stop Maha Dijun?
"Hmph, ant!"
Maha Dijun looked down at Lin Mo, Zhantai Xuankun and others below, and said in an extremely domineering manner: "I just throw a sword casually, are you going to use all your means?"
"It seems that the supporting role I just set for you is very accurate."
"If you only have this small means, I will ask you to die next!"
When the words fell.
Maha Dijun waved the Holy Dragon Sword again, seemingly not intending to give Lin Mo and others any chance to breathe.
See this scene.
Zhan Tai Duoduo looked at Lin Mo helplessly, with the last hope in her golden phoenix eyes.
With Zhantai Xuankun being seriously injured and defeated, the only person who has a chance to save the Nirvana Tianfeng tribe is probably Lin Mo...
Although, Lin Mo's supreme holy-level natal treasure no longer poses any threat to Maha Emperor Jun at this moment.
But...
Besides Lin Mo, who else can Zhan Tai Duoduo rely on now?
"..."
At this time, Lin Mo, who had been silent for a while, finally raised his eyes again.
There was a helpless smile on his lips, as if he was helpless about the current situation.
Needless to say, Lin Mo was really at his wits end when faced with Maha Emperor Jun in his current state.
At least.
With his current strength, he is still unable to compete with Mahadir Jun, who holds a high-grade holy treasure and has perfect cultivation in the Mahayana period.
"The Ancient Dragon Scripture: The Golden Dragon Destroys the World!"
"Roar!"
